docs.title: Sojourn documentation
docs.text: Sojourn is in development. These pages cover what is in the package today and grow with every sprint.

docs.title: Start here: three steps, about 25 minutes
docs.text:
1. Install Sojourn About 10 minutesInstall the package in a sandbox or production org and open the Sojourn app.
  2. Assign permission sets About 5 minutesGive admins, managers, and everyone else the access Sojourn needs.
  3. Track an object About 10 minutesChoose an object and its fields in Sojourn Settings so Sojourn records how long each record spends in each value and with each owner.

docs.title: New here?
docs.text:
Sojourn records how long every record spends in each status and with each owner, in business hours, as plain rows you can report on. Each Tracked field gets its own lane.

Sample data. The Coral part of the Status lane is time past the Goal.

See what Sojourn doesPricing

docs.title: Sprint 3: Flow template and Sojourn Settings (12 October 2026)
docs.text:
• The Sojourn Settings page, with a Sojourn menu that folds into icons and remembers the choice.
  • Add any object Sojourn can track from a searchable list, with no API names to type.
  • Choose Tracked fields, Track owner, status field and closed values, name field, business hours, up to five snapshot fields, record types, and Live values fields on one screen.
  • Pause and Resume capture per object, with the time the pause started.
  • A capture status for every Tracked object: Tracked by package, Flow active, Flow missing, or Flow unknown, with Re-check.
  • The Sojourn Capture Template Flow and four steps on screen to turn on capture for any other object.
  • Org-wide Tracking enabled and default business hours, saved with Save settings.
  • Shorter API names: the namespace already names the package, so components no longer repeat it.

docs.title: Sprint 2: capture engine (11 October 2026)
docs.text:
• Automatic capture on Case, Lead, and Opportunity: a save that changes a Tracked field closes the open Interval and opens the next.
  • The Sojourn: Capture Change Flow action, for any other object.
  • Time with each owner, user or queue, through a Tracked field on the owner.
  • Business and calendar minutes on every Interval, with business hours chosen per field, record, queue, object, or org.
  • Pause Capture and Paused Since on the Tracked object, for bulk imports.
  • The source of every Interval: Trigger, Flow, or Catch-Up.
  • Tracking errors instead of failed saves, of type DML, Limit, Config, BusinessHours, or Unknown.

docs.title: Sprint 1: data model (11 October 2026)
docs.text:
• Configuration objects: Tracked object and Tracked field, with queue business hours and Goals.
  • The Interval object, which records each stay in a value of a Tracked field, with business and calendar minutes.
  • Interval summaries, tracking errors, purge runs, and the Interval archive big object.
  • Fields Sojourn adds to Case, Lead, and Opportunity.
  • Permission sets Sojourn Admin, Sojourn Manager, and Sojourn User, with tabs and the Sojourn app.
  • Report types for intervals, joins to Case, Lead, and Opportunity, summaries, Goals, and errors.

docs.title: Sprint 0: foundation (11 October 2026)
docs.text:
• Package structure for Sojourn and Sojourn Omni-Channel.
  • Org-wide settings in the Sojourn Settings custom setting.
  • Continuous integration with Salesforce Code Analyzer and a 90 percent coverage gate.

docs.title: Report cookbook
docs.text: Tell us the report you need and we will write it up first.

docs.title: Filter by object, then field, then value
docs.text:
Every interval belongs to one Tracked object and one Tracked field. Before you group by Value, filter or group by Tracked object and then Tracked field. A grouping that mixes fields adds Status minutes to Owner minutes, and the totals stop meaning anything.

Worked examples for time in status, time per owner, and hours per case arrive with the packaged reports.

docs.title: Before you install
docs.text:
• Salesforce Enterprise, Unlimited, Performance, or Developer Edition.
  • Business hours defined in Setup, under Business Hours. Sojourn uses the org default unless you set others.

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
Release 1 is in development, so there is no AppExchange listing yet. Early access customers receive a package version ID from CloudAlgo. Request a package version ID.

  1. Install the package version, using the ID you were given:

    sf package install --package 04t... --target-org my-sandbox --wait 20

  2. Assign permission sets, as described in Assign permission sets.

  3. Open the Sojourn app from the App Launcher.

You are done when

  • The Sojourn app appears in the App Launcher.
  • The app opens with an Intervals tab in its navigation.

docs.title: Assign permission sets
docs.text:
Sojourn ships three permission sets. Give each person the one that matches what they do.

Permission set Give it to What it allows Sojourn Admin Admins who configure tracking Create, edit, and delete all Sojourn records, including Tracked objects, Tracked fields, Goals, and queue business hours. Includes the Sojourn Admin custom permission. Sojourn Manager People who report on intervals Read all intervals and interval summaries, and read Goals and tracking configuration. Sojourn User Everyone who should see intervals Read intervals, Goals, and Tracked objects.

The objects and rights each one grants are listed in Reference: Permission sets.

docs.title: Assign in Setup
docs.text:
1. In Setup, open Permission Sets.
  2. Select the permission set, then Manage Assignments, then Add Assignment.
  3. Choose the users and select Assign.

docs.title: Assign with the Salesforce CLI
docs.text:
sf org assign permset --name Admin --target-org my-sandbox

Often missed. Reports join intervals to Cases, Leads, and Opportunities. A manager also needs read access to those records to see them in a joined report.

You are done when

  • Each person has exactly one Sojourn permission set.
  • An admin sees the Sojourn Settings tab; a manager sees Intervals and Interval Summaries.

docs.title: Track an object
docs.text: You set up tracking in the Sojourn Settings tab of the Sojourn app. The page has a Sojourn menu on the left: Overview and Tracked objects today, with more screens joining it in later releases. Choose Collapse menu at its foot to fold it into icons; Sojourn remembers the choice in your browser. The tab needs the Sojourn Admin permission set; without it the page says so and shows nothing else. Changing the overview settings also needs the Customize Application permission, which system administrators have.

docs.title: Add an object
docs.text:
1. Open the Sojourn app and the Sojourn Settings tab, then Tracked objects in the menu.
  2. Choose Add object, search for the object, pick it, and choose Add object again. The list shows only objects Sojourn can track, so you never type an API name; objects you already track are marked Already tracked.
  3. On the object's screen, check the Tracked fields whose time in each value you want; they appear in the list beside the checkboxes, where Remove takes one off. Picklists, lookups, checkboxes, dates, and short text fields are offered; formulas, auto-numbers, and long text are not.
  4. Leave Track owner on to measure time with each user and each queue.
  5. Choose Save.

docs.title: Settings on the object's screen
docs.text:
• Status field and Closed values: the main status field and the values that mean the record is closed.
  • Name field: the field shown as the record's name on each Interval.
  • Business hours, or Business hours from a record field: the hours used for this object's business minutes.
  • Snapshot fields: up to 5 fields copied onto each Interval, for grouping reports by values such as priority.
  • Record types: track only these record types; leave empty for all.
  • Live values and its two minute fields: number fields on the record for the minutes in the current status and with the current owner. You can set them now; the job that keeps them current arrives in sprint 4.

docs.title: Check that capture is live
docs.text:
Each Tracked object shows a pill:

Pill Meaning Tracked by package Case, Lead, and Opportunity: Sojourn's own triggers capture every change. Flow active An active Sojourn capture Flow runs on this object. Flow missing No capture Flow runs yet. Follow the steps on the object's screen. Flow unknown Sojourn could not read your Flows, usually because you lack View Setup and Configuration. Paused Capture is paused for a bulk import. Inactive The object is configured but not tracked.

While an object's pill reads Flow missing or Flow unknown, its screen leads with four steps, and its fields and settings show as a summary until you choose Edit. On the Tracked objects list, Set up Flow opens those steps and Re-check Flows checks every object at once:

  1. In Setup, open Flows and the Sojourn Capture Template, then choose Save As, a new Flow. Keep "Sojourn" in the label.
  2. On the Start element, choose your object.
  3. In Sojourn: Capture Change, set the object for Record and Prior record to the same object.
  4. Activate the Flow, then choose Re-check on the object's screen. The pill turns to Flow active.

If both a trigger and a Flow capture the same change in one save, Sojourn records it once. Each Interval records how the change arrived in its Source field: Trigger, Flow, or Catch-Up.

Often missed. Setup objects such as User and Group cannot be tracked. Salesforce does not allow their changes and Sojourn's Intervals to be saved in one transaction, so Sojourn leaves them out of the list.

docs.title: Pause capture during a bulk import
docs.text: Choose Pause on the Tracked object, in the list or on its screen, before a large import or update, and Resume afterwards. The list shows when the pause started. To stop tracking an object, turn off Active on its screen and choose Save; Turn on in the list brings it back. While paused, triggers and Flows skip the object, so the import runs without Sojourn's work. The catch-up job that replays the records changed during the pause arrives in sprint 4.

docs.title: Business hours for each Interval
docs.text:
Sojourn uses the first of these that is set:

  1. The Tracked field's business hours.
  2. A business hours field on the record, chosen in Business hours from a record field.
  3. The queue's entry in Queue Business Hours, while a queue owns the record.
  4. The Tracked object's business hours.
  5. The default on the Sojourn Settings overview.
  6. The org default business hours.

If none applies, or the chosen business hours no longer exist, the Interval gets calendar minutes as business minutes, and a Tracking error of type BusinessHours tells you which setting to fix.

docs.title: Tracking errors
docs.text:
Sojourn never fails your users' saves. If it cannot record a change, it writes a Tracking error instead; the overview shows how many are open and links to them. Error Type tells you what happened:

  • DML: the Interval could not be saved.
  • Limit: the transaction was too close to a governor limit, so Sojourn stepped aside.
  • Config: a Tracked field names a field that does not exist.
  • BusinessHours: no usable business hours applied, so calendar minutes were recorded.
  • Unknown: anything else; the stack trace is kept for support.

Each row keeps the record, field, and values, so the repair action in sprint 4 can replay it. To stop all capture at once, turn off Tracking enabled on the overview and choose Save settings.

You are done when the object's pill reads Tracked by package or Flow active, and changing a Tracked field on a record opens a new Interval for it and closes the previous one.

docs.title: Sojourn Settings
docs.text:
API name: Settings__c

Field API name Type Description Default Business Hours Id Default_Business_Hours_Id__c Text (18) BusinessHours Id used when no object, field, or queue override applies. Empty means the org default. Limit Reserve CPU Ms Limit_Reserve_CPU_Ms__c Number (6, 0) CPU milliseconds Sojourn leaves unused. Default 2000. Limit Reserve DML Rows Limit_Reserve_DML_Rows__c Number (6, 0) DML rows Sojourn leaves unused. Default 2000. Limit Reserve Queries Limit_Reserve_Queries__c Number (4, 0) SOQL queries Sojourn leaves unused in the host transaction. Default 10. Live Job Interval Minutes Live_Job_Interval_Minutes__c Number (3, 0) How often the live values job runs. Default 15. Live Values Window Days Live_Values_Window_Days__c Number (4, 0) Open intervals older than this are not refreshed by the live job. Default 90. Omni Open Statuses Omni_Open_Statuses__c Text (255) Comma-separated AgentWork statuses that open an agent interval. Default Assigned,Opened. Tracking Enabled Tracking_Enabled__c Checkbox Master switch. When false, no intervals are written.

docs.title: Tracked Field
docs.text:
API name: Tracked_Field__c

Field API name Type Description Business Hours Id Business_Hours_Id__c Text (18) Business hours override for this field.Help text: Business hours used for this field, overriding the tracked object's. Empty means inherit. Field API Name Field_API_Name__c Text (255) API name of the field whose values Sojourn records.Help text: API name of the field, for example Status or OwnerId. Field Label Field_Label__c Text (255) Label shown on intervals and in the Settings page.Help text: Label shown on intervals and in Sojourn Settings. Field Type Field_Type__c Picklist: Picklist, Lookup, Owner, Text, Checkbox, Date Kind of field, which decides how values are stored on intervals.Help text: Picklist stores the API value and label; Lookup and Owner store the display name and Id. Active Is_Active__c Checkbox Whether this field currently produces intervals.Help text: Inactive fields keep their history but stop producing new intervals. Tracked Object Tracked_Object__c Master-detail (Tracked_Object__c) The tracked object this field belongs to. Unique Code Unique_Code__c Text (255) Object API name, a dot, and field API name. Set automatically; enforces one row per object and field.Help text: Set automatically as object API name, a dot, and field API name.

docs.title: Tracked Object
docs.text:
API name: Tracked_Object__c

Field API name Type Description Backfill Message Backfill_Message__c LongTextArea (32768) Result or error from the last backfill run.Help text: Last backfill result. Errors list the records that could not be imported. Backfill Mode Backfill_Mode__c Picklist: History, Seed, Fresh How existing records get intervals when tracking starts.Help text: History imports native field history, Seed opens an interval from current values, Fresh starts empty. Backfill Status Backfill_Status__c Picklist: None, Queued, Running, Complete, Failed State of the last backfill for this object.Help text: Updated by the backfill job. Run backfill from Sojourn Settings. Business Hours Id Business_Hours_Id__c Text (18) Business hours override for this object; the org default applies when empty.Help text: Business hours used for this object when no field or queue override applies. Empty means the org default. Business Hours Source Field Business_Hours_Source_Field__c Text (255) Field on the tracked record that holds a Business Hours Id, checked before the object override.Help text: API name of a field on the record that holds a Business Hours Id, for example BusinessHoursId on Case. Capture Mode Capture_Mode__c Picklist: Trigger, Flow Shows how changes reach Sojourn; the engine does not branch on it.Help text: Case, Lead, and Opportunity use the packaged trigger. Other objects use a Flow cloned from the Sojourn template. Closed Values Closed_Values__c LongTextArea (1000) Values of the primary status field that mean the record is closed.Help text: Comma-separated values of the primary status field that mean closed, for example Closed, Resolved. Active Is_Active__c Checkbox Whether Sojourn records intervals for this object.Help text: Sojourn records intervals only for active tracked objects. Live Owner Minutes Field Live_Owner_Minutes_Field__c Text (255) Number field on the record that Live values writes with business minutes with the current owner.Help text: API name of a Number field on the record. Live values writes business minutes with the current owner to it. Live State Minutes Field Live_State_Minutes_Field__c Text (255) Number field on the record that Live values writes with business minutes in the current state.Help text: API name of a Number field on the record. Live values writes business minutes in the current state to it. Live Values Enabled Live_Values_Enabled__c Checkbox Opts this object into the Live values job.Help text: Refresh open intervals and the live fields on every Live values run. Lookup Field Override Lookup_Field_Override__c Text (255) Chooses which Interval lookup to fill when two lookups target this object.Help text: API name of the lookup on Interval to fill when more than one points at this object. Name Field Name_Field__c Text (255) Field shown as the record's name on intervals.Help text: Field shown as the record's name on intervals, for example CaseNumber or Name. Object API Name Object_API_Name__c Text (255) API name of the tracked object, the key the capture engine matches on.Help text: API name of the tracked object, for example Case or Work_Order__c. Pause Capture Pause_Capture__c Checkbox Pauses live capture for this object during a bulk import; catch-up replays the changes afterwards.Help text: Turn on before a bulk import. Live capture skips this object until you turn it off; then run Catch up. Paused Since Paused_Since__c DateTime Start of the pause window that catch-up replays.Help text: Set when capture is paused. Catch up replays records changed since this time, then clears it. Record Type Filter Record_Type_Filter__c LongTextArea (1000) Limits tracking to the listed record types.Help text: Comma-separated record type developer names to track. Empty means all record types. Snapshot Fields Snapshot_Fields__c LongTextArea (1000) Field API names copied onto each interval for reporting.Help text: Up to five field API names, comma-separated, copied onto each interval as Snapshot 1 to 5. Status Field Status_Field__c Text (255) API name of the primary status field; Closed Values, goals, and Live values refer to it.Help text: API name of the main status or stage field, for example Status or StageName. Track Owner Track_Owner__c Checkbox Adds an Owner tracked field automatically so time with each owner is recorded.Help text: Also track time with each owner.

docs.title: Tracking Error
docs.text:
API name: Tracking_Error__c

Field API name Type Description Changed By Changed_By__c Lookup (User) Who made the change that failed to record.Help text: Who made the change. Error Type Error_Type__c Picklist: DML, Limit, Config, BusinessHours, Unknown Category of failure, which decides whether reconcile retries it automatically.Help text: DML and Limit errors are retried by reconcile. Config and BusinessHours errors need an admin. From Value From_Value__c Text (255) Value before the failed change.Help text: Value before the change. Message Message__c LongTextArea (32768) Error message as captured. Occurred At Occurred_At__c DateTime When the change happened, used as the interval boundary on repair.Help text: When the change happened. Owner Id Owner_Id__c Text (18) Owner of the record when the change happened. Parent Id Parent_Id__c Text (18) Id of the tracked record the failed change belongs to.Help text: Id of the tracked record. Parent Object Parent_Object__c Text (255) API name of the tracked object. Repaired Interval Repaired_Interval__c Lookup (Interval__c) Interval created when the error was repaired. Retry Count Retry_Count__c Number (3, 0) Times reconcile retried this error; retries stop at the configured maximum.Help text: Times the nightly reconcile retried this error. Source Source__c Picklist: Trigger, Flow, Backfill-History, Backfill-Seed, Manual-Repair, Reconcile, Catch-Up Which capture path produced the error. Stack Stack__c LongTextArea (32768) Stack trace, truncated.Help text: Stack trace for support. Status Status__c Picklist: New, Resolved, Ignored Workflow state of the error in the repair queue.Help text: New errors wait for repair or retry. Resolved and Ignored errors are kept for audit. To Value Id To_Value_Id__c Text (18) Id behind the new value for lookup and owner changes, needed to replay the change.Help text: Id of the user, queue, or related record for lookup and owner changes. To Value To_Value__c Text (255) Value after the failed change.Help text: Value after the change. Tracked Field Tracked_Field__c Text (255) API name of the tracked field whose change failed.Help text: API name of the tracked field.

docs.title: Code Analyzer results
docs.text:
The Code Analyzer workflow scans the package directories sojourn/ and sojourn-omni/ on every pull request, every push to main, and every week. It runs the AppExchange and Recommended rule selectors, which include every rule in the command the AppExchange security review prescribes, and Salesforce Graph Engine, which follows data from each entry point through the Apex classes to find missing access checks. This page is generated from those scans, and the workflow fails when the page and the scans disagree.

docs.title: Rules turned off
docs.text: Rule Engine Reason ApexDoc pmd Accepted (D-308): the documentation standard is a one-line purpose comment on every class and on every non-obvious member; full ApexDoc blocks with @param and @return on every member only restate signatures. TriggerEntryCriteria flow Accepted (D-321): a Sojourn capture Flow must see every create and update; the engine decides which tracked fields changed, so entry criteria on the template would hide changes.
